[autotest] audio_AudioBasicExternalMicrophone: Change test frequency We use 0.0015 ms as block size when checking quality. When the rate is 48000, it is equal to 48000 * 0.0015 = 72 frames. However, the length of one wave in 440 HZ stream is 48000 / 440 = 109 frames. It is too large to test. So we change the higher frequency file, 48000 / 1330 = 36 frames is enough. BUG=chromium:896141 TEST=run audio_AudioBasicExternalMicrophone.quality test.
